feature_contract.goal: Prevent a transient near-pole or outlier OpenXR eye FOV from distorting the entire forward-centered native OutRun menu across both eyes; preserve legitimate asymmetric Quest FOV and 4:3/full-width car-selection content.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only LOCAL menu shared tangent FOV planning (R23 host); no automatic 4:3 crop, car selection content removal, game HUD/F11/ESC, graphics world stereo, R26_SAFE, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: R23 host menu obtains both eye FOVs; PlanCommonFovTangents transforms each per-eye angle to tangent space and averages them.
An eye with ±1.50 rad aperture previously passed the <1.55 angle pole guard and span>0.05 check but its ~28-unit tangent span contaminated the shared menu aspect.
Reject any single out-of-bounds 10-tangent-unit horizontal/vertical span before combining the eyes; valid shared FOV retains exact original arithmetic and downstream optical/UV placement.
subcomponents: Reject impossible per-eye horizontal and vertical spans before the common menu tangent projection.
Retain tested asymmetric Quest left/right values, original content UV, desktop/full-car selection and reset reentry behavior.
Require exact-SHA DX9Ex Active R84 game/host/package, R26_SAFE, Domain and impacted Full Source/Host gates before build-complete; HMD separately untested.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R23 LOCAL menu shared eye optical extent during transient XR recenter
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A near-pole eye with >10 tangent span cannot distort the other eye; menu uses safe invalid-FOV fallback.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Quest3 asymmetric optics, 4:3/16:9/21:9 car selection crop and reset transitions
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Normal asymmetric FOV stays valid, full native menu side content and all unchanged non-menu stereo and fallback paths remain intact.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game / R26_SAFE rollback / x64 OpenXR host / deployment ZIP, Domain/Full Source
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required final exact-source-SHA GitHub actions pass before calling it build-verified; Quest3 HMD remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The pre-change R23 menu helper accepted ±1.50 rad per-eye horizontal/vertical bounds because abs(angle)<1.55 even though tan(+1.50)-tan(-1.50) is about 28, exceeding the already bounded pause-menu tangent-extent contract.
diagnosis.root_cause: Shared two-eye menu FOV was composed before checking each eye's usable tangent span, allowing a single near-pole publication to change the other eye's authored menu aspect.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Check both per-eye tangent spans against 0.05..10.0 before averaging; retain all normal asymmetric FOV and 4:3/21:9 menu paths.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable menu_content_aspect_smoke now includes near-pole single-eye horizontal and vertical negatives in addition to asymmetric positive and recenter recovery cases.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No user Quest3/VDXR playback or measured performance data. Normal FOV unchanged.
